CustomField.description: Priority of the case as per ANZ process guidelines.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For Complaint Cases: While all customers may experience vulnerability due to their circumstances and require extra care, certain characteristics may increase the risk e.g. age, disability, mental health conditions, cognitive impairment, serious medical conditions, elder abuse, family and/or domestic violence, financial abuse, Financial Difficulty, literacy or language barriers, cultural background, Aboriginal/Torres Strait Islanders, remote location, incarceration.
